summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for post-procedural monitoring and pain control following an elective bronchoscopy with balloon dilation of the trachea and mainstem bronchi, along with debridement of granulation tissue, due to recurrent tracheobronchial stenosis from Ruvalcaba-Myhre-Smith syndrome and relapsing polychondritis. The procedure was uncomplicated, and he was managed with acetaminophen, ibuprofen, and oxycodone for pain, with successful weaning off opioids 24 hours before discharge. A transient right lung opacity noted on post-procedure imaging resolved without intervention and was not consistent with infection. Biopsy of the left mainstem lesion revealed benign granulation tissue without malignancy. His home medications were continued, except pirfenidone, which was held due to formulary restrictions. He remained stable, with improving lab values and no complications, and was discharged home in good condition with follow-up planned.
